settingsJsonPrecedence: 5. System overrides, env vars, and CLI flags
configurationAndTomlSystem.tomlCustomCommands: Reusable slash commands defined as .toml files (e.g., ~/.gemini/commands/*.toml or extension commands/<ns>/<cmd>.toml) supporting prompt templates, {{args}}, and !{...} shell execution; reloaded via /commands reload
configurationAndTomlSystem.tomlPolicyEngine: Granular tool-execution rules in ~/.gemini/policies/*.toml and extension policies/ using [[rule]] blocks (toolName, commandPrefix, decision: allow|deny|ask_user, priority). 5 priority tiers: Default (1) < Extension (2) < Workspace (3) < User (4) < Admin (5). Inspected via /policies list.

stdio.mechanism: Local child subprocess spawned by MCP host; JSON-RPC over stdin/stdout
stdio.authModel: Implicit OS process-boundary identity; credentials passed via env vars or OS keychain. OAuth 2.1 MUST NOT be used on stdio.
stdio.primaryRisks: Untrusted repository config launching arbitrary shell commands without interactive approval

streamableHttp.specMilestone: Introduced in MCP spec 2025-03-26, refined in 2025-06-18 and 2025-11-25
streamableHttp.mechanism: Single remote HTTP endpoint accepting POST requests and optional SSE response streams; supports multi-client remote hosting
streamableHttp.authModel: OAuth 2.1 Resource Server: mandatory PKCE, RFC 9728 Protected Resource Metadata (401 + WWW-Authenticate), RFC 8414 / OIDC Discovery, RFC 7591 Dynamic Client Registration / Client ID Metadata Docs, RFC 8707 Resource Indicators (audience binding prohibiting token passthrough)
transportHardening: Validate Origin header on all incoming connections (return 403 Forbidden if invalid to block DNS rebinding)
Bind local HTTP servers strictly to 127.0.0.1 rather than 0.0.0.0

dynamicToolSearchAndContextBloat.problem: Preloading raw JSON tool schemas from multiple MCP servers consumes 50,000+ tokens upfront, degrading LLM reasoning, raising latency, and widening the Tool Poisoning attack surface.
dynamicToolSearchAndContextBloat.mitigationPattern: Deferred tool loading (`defer_loading: true`) paired with on-demand Tool Search (`ENABLE_TOOL_SEARCH=true|auto` in Claude Code), discovering only the 3-5 relevant tools per turn and cutting schema token overhead by ~85%+.

toolPoisoning.mechanism: Malicious MCP server embeds hidden indirect prompt injection inside tool `description`, parameter schemas, or return values that the LLM treats as trusted instructions at discovery time.
toolPoisoning.mitigation: Cryptographic schema hash pinning, human review of tool metadata, and MCP Gateway prompt-injection scanning.

rugPull.mechanism: Server behaves benignly during initial vetting/approval, then mutates `tools/list` metadata or package behavior post-approval (e.g., CVE-2025-54136).
rugPull.mitigation: Pin exact tool schema hashes locally and invalidate approval / block execution on any description or signature drift.

excessiveAgency.mechanism: Agent holds high-privilege local tools (filesystem write, shell, DB admin) simultaneously with untrusted external MCP servers, turning localized injection into full system compromise.
excessiveAgency.mitigation: Least-privilege scoping, read-only default sandboxes, tool exclusion lists, and PreToolUse/TOML policy guardrails.

ssrf.mechanism: Attacker manipulates MCP resource URLs or parameters to force server-side HTTP fetches to internal VPC microservices, cloud metadata IPs, or localhost ports.
ssrf.mitigation: Strict URL/domain allowlisting, private-IP egress blocking, input validation, and RFC 8707 audience-bound tokens.

CLAUDE.md.precedenceAndLoading: Cumulative concatenation from Managed (/etc/claude-code) -> User (~/.claude) -> Project -> Subdirs -> CLAUDE.local.md; overrides AGENTS.md if both exist at root
CLAUDE.md.specialFeatures: @./path inline imports (depth ~5); conditional .claude/rules/*.md with YAML `paths` globs

AGENTS.md.primaryTool: OpenAI Codex CLI & cross-tool open standard (Cursor, Copilot, Claude Code fallback, Gemini CLI configurable fallback)
AGENTS.md.precedenceAndLoading: Loaded from repo root/subdirs; Codex PR reviewer natively parses `## Code Review Rules`
AGENTS.md.specialFeatures: Vendor-neutral single source of truth; can be imported via `@./AGENTS.md` inside GEMINI.md or CLAUDE.md

GEMINI.md.precedenceAndLoading: Hierarchical concatenation (global ~/.gemini/GEMINI.md -> workspace root -> subdirs); .gemini/settings.json can configure fallback arrays like ["AGENTS.md", "GEMINI.md"]
GEMINI.md.specialFeatures: @./path imports; runtime inspection/mutation via /memory show, /memory add, /memory reload, and /init

claudeCode.maturity: 33+ granular lifecycle events (SessionStart/End, UserPromptSubmit, PreToolUse/PostToolUse, Stop/StopFailure, SubagentStart/Stop, WorktreeCreate/Remove, TaskCreated/Completed)
claudeCode.enforcement: PreToolUse runs before permission checks and deterministically blocks actions via exit code 2 or JSON deny

geminiCli.maturity: Declarative 5-tier TOML Policy Engine + Extension manifest hooks + PTY stream wrapping
geminiCli.enforcement: Admin > User > Workspace > Extension > Default policy precedence; extension excludeTools union merging

codexCli.maturity: OS-kernel sandbox boundaries + approval policies + CI script wrappers (lacks Claude Code's 33-event inline PreToolUse hook system)
codexCli.enforcement: Kernel-level filesystem/network enforcement independent of model cooperation
